title: Radiomics for precision medicine: Current challenges, future prospects, and the proposal of a new framework

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics for precision medicine: Current challenges, future prospects, and the proposal of a new framework》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The advancement of artificial intelligence concurrent with the development of medical imaging techniques provided a unique opportunity to turn medical imaging from mostly qualitative, to further quantitative and mineable data that can be explored for the development of clinical decision support systems (cDSS).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Radiomics for precision medicine: Current challenges, future prospects, and the proposal of a new framework》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Such techniques could be highly appealing due to the reuse of existing data, automation of clinical workflows, minimal invasiveness, three-dimensional volumetric characterization, and the promise of high accuracy and reproducibility of results and cost-effectiveness.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】These challenges include, but are not limited to, the explainability of the models, the reproducibility of the quantitative imaging features, and their sensitivity to variations in image acquisition and reconstruction parameters.
